key_insight: SynDebug brings debugging into fault-tolerant quantum computing itself, using lightweight assertions that work inside encoded QEC workflows without materially increasing logical error.
engineering_relevance: It gives quantum software and systems engineers a practical way to catch logic bugs in real FTQC execution paths while preserving fault tolerance and keeping overhead very low.
method: Assertion-based debugging primitives embedded in encoded FTQC circuits
Designed to avoid extra logical surface area and minimize temporal overhead
Supports realistic QEC flows across multiple code families and code distances
evidence_signal: Across multiple QEC families, distances, and workloads, SynDebug averaged 1.8% added circuit depth overhead, was 0% in most cases, and showed no measurable increase in logical error rate.
watch_item: The approach depends on careful integration with encoded FTQC stacks, so deployment must ensure the added assertions do not interfere with code-specific decoding or runtime scheduling.
paper_title: SynDebug: A Framework to Debug Logic Bugs in Fault-Tolerant Quantum Computing Programs
